source.section: Schedule SB (PDF page 1) and its Instructions: line 12 (SB Instructions PDF page 6; Publication 126 PDF pages 5-6 section 4.D); Form 1 lines 1-12 (Form 1 PDF page 1); Form 1 Instructions PDF page 15 line 8 and lines 10a-10b (PDF pages 15-16), PDF pages 35-37 2025 Standard Deduction Table (row named in worked), PDF page 15 line 12 with the PDF pages 38-43 Tax Table and PDF page 44 Tax Computation Worksheet; tax figured from the 2025 Tax Rate Schedules, Publication 106 PDF pages 6-7

worked: Single, 60: U.S. military retirement pay 30,000 (paid by DFAS) and wages 40,000. Schedule SB line 12 subtracts the military retirement pay included in federal AGI in full. Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (you) 40,000.00 + military pension paid by federal (you) 30,000.00 = 70,000.00. Federal taxable income = 70,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 54,250.00; the federal senior deduction is ignored. Form 1 line 1 federal AGI 70,000.00; line 2 Schedule I adjustments 0.00; line 3 70,000.00; line 4 additions 0.00; line 5 70,000.00. Schedule SB: line 12 military retirement pay = 30,000.00; line 50 total 30,000.00. Form 1 line 6 30,000.00; line 7 Wisconsin income = 70,000.00 - 30,000.00 = 40,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction, 2025 Standard Deduction Table (Form 1 Instructions PDF page 35), row 40,000 to less than 40,500, column Single: 11,076.00 (printed row, at least / less than / single / joint / separate / head of household: 40,000 / 40,500 / 11,076 / 22,729 / 6,618 / 12,859). Line 9 = 40,000.00 - 11,076.00 = 28,924.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 28,924.00 - 700.00 = 28,224.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule A (single) as numbers: 3.5% x 14,680.00 = 513.80 + 4.4% x 13,544.00 = 595.936; total 1,109.736, rounded once to 1,109.74. The Tax Table row 28,200 to 28,300 (PDF page 39) gives 1,111; expected keeps the schedule. Credits (lines 13-20, 30-35): none modelled; 0.00. State income tax 1,109.74.
